name: Bead Up
description: The first clip is a thin film of liquid on glass that pulls itself apart like water on a waxed surface: dry holes open and grow with glossy rolled rims, meet in a web of ridges, the ridges break into round beads that magnify the picture, and the beads dry up over the second clip. Drive `progress` from 0 to 1.

inputs.name: second
inputs.description: Incoming clip (same size as the first)

params.name: holes
params.description: Number of rows of holes across the frame

params.name: rim
params.description: Radius of the rims and beads, in frame heights (at most a seventh of the space between holes)

params.name: gloss
params.description: Strength of the reflections and of the magnification in the liquid
